title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 part 1 — Bitcoin.com and BitPay lifecycle updates
notes: Candidate IDs are provisional. Both records use dated first-party product announcements and do not infer original product launch dates.

events.title: Bitcoin.com Wallet added native TRON support
events.description: Bitcoin.com announced native TRON support in the Bitcoin.com Wallet app, adding in-app support for holding, sending, swapping, and buying TRX and USDT on TRON.

events.title: BitPay Wallet added XRP buy, sell, and swap support
events.description: BitPay announced that XRP buying, selling, and swapping became available directly in the self-custody BitPay Wallet for eligible users, expanding existing XRP storage and spending support.

evidence.title: Bitcoin.com Wallet Adds Native TRON Support, Bringing TRX and USDT-TRC20 to Millions of Users
evidence.notes: First-party Bitcoin.com announcement dated 2026-08-21; used only for the TRON integration event, not the wallet's original launch date.

evidence.title: Buy, Sell, and Swap XRP: Now Available in the BitPay Wallet
